message.source: All items in the group will also be deleted.
message.translation: 分组内的内容也会被删除。

message.source: Are you sure you want to delete this group?\nAll items in the group will also be deleted.
message.translation: 确定要删除这个分组吗？\n分组内的内容也会被删除。

message.source: Preview shortened; copy the item for its full content.
message.translation: 预览已截短，复制记录可获取完整内容。

message.source: Current clipboard database path is unavailable.
message.translation: 无法获取当前剪贴板数据库路径。
选择剪贴板数据文件夹

message.source: The selected folder is already the current location.
Please choose a folder outside the current clipboard images folder.
message.translation: 请选择当前剪贴板图片文件夹之外的位置。

message.source: The selected folder already contains clipboard data. Replace it with the current data?
message.translation: 所选文件夹已包含剪贴板数据。要用当前数据替换吗？

message.source: Failed to close the current clipboard database.
message.translation: 关闭当前剪贴板数据库失败。
剪贴板数据位置已更改。

message.source: Clipboard data location changed successfully, but the old files are still in use and could not be deleted. You can remove them after restarting the app.\n{error}
message.translation: 剪贴板数据位置已更改，但旧文件仍被占用，暂时无法删除。重启应用后可以手动删除。\n{error}

message.source: Clipboard data moved, but reopening the database failed. Please restart the app.
message.translation: 剪贴板数据已移动，但重新打开数据库失败。请重启应用。

message.source: No clipboard data files were found to move.
message.translation: 没有找到可移动的剪贴板数据文件。
选择浅色、深色或跟随系统。

message.source: Size of toolbars, tool panels and popups.
message.translation: 调整截图工具栏、面板和弹出控件的大小。

message.source: Font and size of application windows.
message.translation: 调整设置等应用窗口的文字和控件大小。

message.source: Hidden handles can still be dragged to resize.
message.translation: 隐藏控制点后，仍可拖动边角调整选区。
调整选区边角控制点的大小。

message.source: This hotkey is assigned more than once.
Drag the handle to reorder. Use the drop-down to change visibility.
message.translation: 拖动左侧手柄排序，在下拉菜单中选择显示位置。

message.source: No QR code or barcode found
message.translation: 未识别到二维码或条形码

message.source: Make sure the whole code is inside the selection.
message.translation: 请确认码完整地框在选区内。

message.source: No text found in the selection.
message.translation: 未识别到文字，请尝试重新框选清晰的文字区域。

message.source: This build does not include the text recognition engine.
message.translation: 当前版本不包含文字识别引擎。
识别失败，请重新截图后再试。

message.source: Checked formats show on the magnifier. The first one is what the copy shortcut puts on the clipboard — drag it to the top to change that.
message.translation: 勾选要显示的颜色格式。快捷键会复制排在首位的格式，拖动即可调整顺序。

message.source: Already in use by another app.

message.translation: 在其他应用中也可使用

message.source: Only in screenshot and pin windows
message.translation: 仅在截图和钉图窗口中生效

message.source: All items in the group will also be deleted.
message.translation: 分组中的所有内容也将被删除。

message.source: Are you sure you want to delete this group?
message.translation: 确定要删除这个分组吗？
输入要遮盖的关键词，用逗号分隔

message.source: Matched lines are covered in full. Uncheck to keep; drag on the image to cover more.
message.translation: 匹配内容按整行遮盖。取消勾选可保留；也可在图片上拖动，手动添加遮盖。
正在准备图片文字搜索…

message.source: Name this group and choose how its contents are used.
message.translation: 设置分组名称，以及内容的使用方式。

message.source: Save reusable text or file paths in this group.
message.translation: 将常用文本或文件路径保存到当前分组。

message.source: Edit the content, then save your changes.
message.translation: 编辑内容后，点击保存或按 Ctrl+S。

message.source: Transfer saved text and file paths using CSV.
message.translation: 通过 CSV 导入或导出保存的文本与文件路径。
